project_type: Research ML codebase: TF 2.10 groupwise 3D brain MRI registration (rigid / affine / diffeomorphic) with a level 4 -> 2 -> 1 cascade; DALI data pipeline on the cluster, SLURM bash launchers, stdlib login-node helpers
language: Python 3.8 (cluster container tf10_nv.sif: Python 3.8.10, TF 2.10.0, Keras 2.10.0, numpy 1.21.1); bash for slurm/*.sh; login-node helpers (slurm/sweep_level4.py, scripts/summarize_runs.py) must be Python 3.6 syntax + stdlib only
build_system: No build step. Syntax gate = py_compile + ast.parse(feature_version=(3, 8)) in WSL conda env bgr_preproc38 (part of tests/run_tests_wsl.sh step 1). bash -n for SLURM scripts. Local tf_gpu env is Python 3.9 / TF 2.10 and CRASHES without a GPU (do not hide CUDA devices).
test_framework: unittest. Every TF test module imports `tests.tf_setup` FIRST (TF32 off, memory growth or BGR_TF_GPU_LIMIT_MB). TF-free tests (tests.test_slurm_scripts, tests.test_memory_model, ...) run in bgr_preproc38 and must not import TF; the new tests/test_sweep_tools.py is TF-free too.
build_command: Syntax only: wsl -d Ubuntu bash -lc 'source ~/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate bgr_preproc38 && cd /mnt/d/Research/Brain_Registration_Projects/brain-group-rad && python -m py_compile <files> && bash -n slurm/r_level4.sh'
test_command: Targeted TF tests (WSL, tf_gpu): wsl -d Ubuntu bash -lc 'source ~/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate tf_gpu && cd /mnt/d/Research/Brain_Registration_Projects/brain-group-rad && export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 TF_CPP_MIN_LOG_LEVEL=3 TF_CUDNN_WORKSPACE_LIMIT_IN_MB=512 BGR_TF_GPU_LIMIT_MB=6000 TF_CUDNN_USE_AUTOTUNE=0 && python -m unittest tests.test_runtime_optim -v'. TF-free tests: same with conda activate bgr_preproc38 and python -m unittest tests.test_sweep_tools tests.test_slurm_scripts -v. Goldens: python -m unittest tests.test_trainer.TestLinearOnlyUnchanged tests.test_trainer.TestDeformUnchanged tests.test_cascade.TestSkip -v (must pass unmodified, max |diff| 0). FULL suite (only once, in the integration step): wsl -d Ubuntu bash /mnt/d/Research/Brain_Registration_Projects/brain-group-rad/tests/run_tests_wsl.sh, run in the background with output redirected to a log file under .agents/tasks/retrain-prereqs/, ~3-3.5 h; baseline 558 tests OK + 4 skips.
verification_instructions: 1) Activate the `shell-and-remote-jobs` skill before composing any WSL command from PowerShell (quoting rules). 2) py_compile + ast feature_version=(3, 8) for changed Python files (bgr_preproc38); feature_version=(3, 6) for slurm/sweep_level4.py and scripts/summarize_runs.py. 3) bash -n on new slurm scripts. 4) Targeted unittest modules of the FEAT (tf_gpu env with BGR_TF_GPU_LIMIT_MB=6000 - never more than 6000 MB). 5) Goldens unmodified: tests.test_trainer.TestLinearOnlyUnchanged, tests.test_trainer.TestDeformUnchanged, tests.test_cascade.TestSkip. 6) Record commands and pass counts in the FEAT's findings.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Golden fixtures tests/fixtures/m7_linear_golden.json and tests/fixtures/lncc_deform_golden.json must NOT be regenerated or edited; every new flag default must keep them at max |diff| 0. No other generated files are checked in. Delete __pycache__ / temp dirs you create (run_tests_wsl.sh removes __pycache__ itself).
environment_constraints: Work directly in d:\Research\Brain_Registration_Projects\brain-group-rad (NO git worktree; use absolute paths). Do NOT git commit, push, ssh, sbatch or touch the Martinos cluster (two cluster jobs are running; the orchestrator handles git and the cluster). Local GPU is an 8 GB GTX 1080 under WSL: TF memory limit <= 6000 MB (BGR_TF_GPU_LIMIT_MB=6000), TINY / narrow model widths only. No DALI locally (DALI tests skip). Windows PowerShell 5.1 strips inner double quotes from native-command args: prefer single-quoted bash -lc strings or a here-string piped to wsl bash -s. The working tree already has an unrelated uncommitted 1-line change in .agents/tasks/network-design/design.md (leave it; FEAT-006 edits that file further).
contribution_requirements: Follow .kiro/steering/cluster-access.md: SLURM scripts use account qtim ONLY (never entre), 1 GPU, -N 1 --ntasks-per-node=1, rtx8000 3 CPUs / 64G (dgx-a100 allowed only after a smoke with gpu_peak <= 36864 MB), --time/--mem/-p/-A mandatory, logs under /autofs/space/crater_001/users/jn85/BrainRegProjects/GroupwiseReg/logs, container /autofs/space/crater_001/users/jn85/Singularity_Files/tf10_nv.sif, at most two active jobs per user (squeue -u jn85 counts everything). Python 3.8 syntax in all cluster code (no PEP 585/604 runtime annotations, no 3.9+ stdlib). New flags default to today's behaviour (bit-identical). Keep the project style: argparse parser.error for user-facing flag errors, ValueError re-checks in Trainer.__init__, docstrings citing the design section.
key_patterns: Flags: runtime/args.py build_parser() groups + parse_args() validation with parser.error; parsed values stored as args.<name>_parsed; TrainConfig built in train_config_from_args(); intensity_aug_tf(args) returns P.IntensityAugConfig(). Trainer (runtime/run.py): trace-time switches (Python bools decide whether ops are built), tf.function step per task with input_signature (cascade steps take a trailing tf.TensorSpec([], tf.bool) skip), stateless draws via random.Random(<string or int seed>), MeanAccumulator windows logged as train_<task>/<key>, fit() sets lr via O.set_learning_rate(self.optimizer, lr_at(s, cfg.schedule)). Cascade (models/cascade.py): FrozenStage (level 2 runs) / FrozenChain (level 1), helpers skip_linear / skip_fields / skip_to under tf.name_scope(SKIP_SCOPE='cascade_skip'), prewarp_linear, prewarp_deform, compose_linear, pool_to_coarser; FrozenChain._linear / _deform / linear_stages / deform_stages. main.py: resume guards like _check_intensity_aug_device(config_path, args) raising SystemExit; cascade record dict cascade_rec written via C.write_config(..., extra=config_extra); logger.log_event(step, dict). SLURM scripts: slurm/m9_level1_cascade.sh is the template (env defaults ${NAME:-...}, case-pattern validation exit 2, BAL_ARGS gradnorm/deform64, CASCADE_FROM guard skipped when ckpt/last/checkpoint exists, singularity exec with binds, then tests/gpu/check_mixed_run.py, exit code main's if non-zero else checker's). Script tests: tests/test_slurm_scripts.py (TestStatic + TestStubRuns with stub singularity on PATH, RECIPE_ENV stripped).
